raw_tower.note: Upright, 3 walls. L-shaped: back + exit walls, leans 3 deg back and 3 deg toward the exit.

gate_plate.note: Foot down. Glue a 1.5 mm silicone pad strip under the foot.

feed_roller.note: Flat on its end, 100% infill. Fit three 24 x 3.5 mm O-rings.

exit_roller.note: Flat on its end, 100% infill. Two 16 x 3.5 mm O-rings each.

stack_weight.note: Add 4 M8 washers in the pocket.

fin.note: 12 + 12 mirrored (10 per side + spares). On its side, 0.12 mm layers. Glue a 3 x 3 mm silicone square in the face pocket.

belt_drill_jig.note: Ridges up. 2 mm drill through the guide holes.

track_pulley_idler.note: Axis vertical, 0.12 mm layers, 100% infill. 2 x 685ZZ each. Test-fit the belt first.

track_pulley_drive.note: Hub down on the plate, 0.12 mm layers, 100% infill. Hub faces the track (inward). M3 nut + M3 x 4 grub.

sensor_clip.note: Holds an Adafruit break-beam half (20 x 10 x 8 housing).

motor_standoff.note: Standing on a side wall, 5 walls. One for the feed motor, one for the track motor. M3 x 8 to the motor, M3 x 10 to the wall.

scan_floor.note: Top face DOWN on the smooth side of the plate: flat, slick, dull.

hood.note: Upside down (roof on the plate), tree supports for the tunnel only. ~16 h.

camera_plate.note: Tabs up. 2 M3 inserts in the tabs; clamps to the hood ribs with 2 x M3 x 10.

bin_side_back.note: On its outer face; one per bin module.

bin_side_front.note: On its outer face; one per bin module.

door.note: Top face down on the smooth plate side (slick surface).

tie_bar.note: Floor plate face DOWN on the smooth side of the plate (slick top).

bin.note: Open side up, 2 walls, 10% infill. Big front window + a fill mark every 100 cards. ~5 h each.

end_ramp.note: Ramp face DOWN on the smooth side of the plate (slick), tree supports under the flange.

skr_post.note: Upright, 100% infill. Holds the SKR Pico 40 mm over the Pi.

inlet_plate.note: Flat. Cutout 47.5 x 27.5 mm for a snap-in C14 inlet; check yours.

channel_cover.note: On its back. Clips over the wire channels.

screen_cradle.note: Face down. Check the display size on arrival. GoPro tab on the back.

mount_bay.note: Screen mount on the electronics bay front (default spot).

mount_wall.note: Bolts to any module wall: between hopper and scanner, or on the back for an arm over the track.

mount_roof.note: Optional: screen on top of the hood.

gopro_arm.note: 100% infill. Or use store-bought GoPro extension arms.
